papers.title: Positive Factorization and a Zero-Energy Resonance of the Schwinger-Coupled Wormhole Mouth
papers.author: Dmitry Kosarevsky · Independent Researcher
papers.summary: An exact positivity identity, a unique bounded threshold resonance, and a conditional weak-attraction binding theorem for a specified three-channel extremal-mouth operator.

editions.title: Positive Factorization and Threshold Transmission for a Three-Channel Extremal-Mouth Operator
editions.status_label: Second edition · Preprint for independent review
editions.summary: An explicit positive factorization, uniqueness of the bounded zero-energy solution, and a threshold transmission theorem for the specified baseline operator. The result concerns classical master flux, not a physical quantum channel.
